description: Update a Tripsy transportation by id. Supported transportation_type slugs: airplane, bike, bus, car, roadtrip, cruise, ferry, motorcycle, subway, train, transfer, walk. Labels: airplane = Flight; bike = Bike; bus = Bus; car = Car Rental; roadtrip = Drive / Road Trip; cruise = Cruise; ferry = Ferry; motorcycle = Motorcycle; subway = Subway; train = Train; transfer = Transfer; walk = Walk. Use only these exact slugs; custom categories are not supported for transportations. Safety: Closed-world: operates within the authenticated user's Tripsy account and accessible trips. Destructive: overwrites supplied fields on an existing Tripsy record; previous values are not automatically preserved or restored by this tool.
